overall: The AG found violations for untimely approval of open session minutes and for inadequate notice of the Sept 28 interview meeting, declined review of the June 20 and Aug 17 notice claims as untimely, and ordered minutes cured, member training, and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Commission failed to create and approve minutes of open meetings (June 15, July 20, Sept 21) within the required deadline.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Commission did not have good cause for its delay in approving meeting minutes and the Commission is in violation of the Open Meeting Law for failure to timely create and approve minutes of at least three meetings.

allegations.summary: Notice for the Sept 28 interview meeting was missing or inadequate: it listed no topics, omitted the open session, and said 'No Board meeting'.
allegations.key_passage: As the Commission failed to notice that it would meet in open session prior to convening in executive session, it violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Notice for the June 20 executive session was alleged to be nonexistent or insufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the complaint was untimely as to those two meetings where it was filed on November 8.

allegations.summary: Notice for the Aug 17 meeting was alleged to be nonexistent or insufficiently specific; the Commission denied it met that day.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the complaint was untimely as to those two meetings where it was filed on November 8.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission failed to produce minutes upon request. The letter restates this allegation but does not separately analyze it.
allegations.key_passage: The complainant alleges that the Commission failed to create and approve meeting minutes in a timely manner or produce minutes upon request.

remedy: Create and approve all outstanding open session meeting minutes within 60 days of the date of the letter and certify to the AG that it has done so.
All members of the Commission attend an Open Meeting Law training webinar within 90 days of the letter and certify to the AG that they have done so.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission to create and approve all outstanding open session meeting minutes within 60 days of the date of this letter, and to certify to our office that it has done so.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
